label: About
title: About Mint Wing Wood Quiet
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 75 recent saved-signal files and 71 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around Anchor image material 1 and @if6ukg: #ポリゴンZの日, plus 7 more. A source image from i.pinimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Mint Wing Wood Quiet: Bright craft-table world, product-photo rupture, overhead scan. A single oversized pale mint cut-paper wing mass enters cropped from the bottom, one white stick slicing diagonally; a smaller deep magenta counterform floats above-right across severe vertical reddish wood grain. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against mint cardstock wing surface, torn paper seams and scars, and foil wrapper glints.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
